summary: First iteration of RideVE tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth, RBAC, wallet, Pago Movil recharges (create/approve/reject), drivers nearby, estimates, full ride lifecycle (request→accept→start→complete with wallet debit/credit 85%), chat, ratings, admin stats and bank-config. Frontend: login with quick-fill works for all 3 roles, passenger home loads with map fallback, drivers count, balance pill ($25 demo), destinations list, estimate calculation and confirm UI; driver home shows online toggle/stats; admin panel shows pending recharges with approve/reject. No critical issues. Seed data verified (admin, demo passenger with $25, demo driver online, 5 simulated drivers, Pago Móvil bank config). Insufficient-balance check returns 402 as designed. Minor: a 'Bienvenido' toast overlaps the admin stats header briefly; RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents) emitted in console — non-breaking.

minor.issue: Warning at startup: passlib cannot read bcrypt __about__ version ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'). Hashing still works (verified by login + register tests). Pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib to silence.

issues: The success toast 'Bienvenido, Administrador' renders over the stats cards header and partially obscures the 'Recargas Pago Móvil' title on small viewports. Consider moving Toast above the header or pushing content with safe top padding.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web deprecation warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Affects styles using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius across components (theme shadows). Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.ts (shadows object) and usages like /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx:114.
RN-web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(passenger)/index.tsx:138 and :151.

action_items: Optional: pin bcrypt<4 in backend/requirements.txt (or upgrade passlib) to remove the startup warning.
Move login success Toast to render below the safe-area top inset on the admin screen so it does not overlap stat cards.

Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.ts and replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on SafeAreaView/View overlays in (passenger)/index.tsx to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~825 lines — acceptable but approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting routers into modules (auth/wallet/rides/admin) for maintainability.
/api/rides/rate updates driver rating_avg by querying all ratings; OK for small scale but could be a counter-based aggregation for scale.
JWT secret is committed in backend/.env (expected for dev). Ensure prod uses a separate secret store.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login×3 roles, passenger pick→estimate, driver/admin dashboards render)

seed_data_creation: No new seeds — used backend-seeded demo accounts. Tests created ephemeral users with TEST_/poor_/test_ prefixes and recharges; no production-equivalent data altered. Demo passenger wallet was modified by full-flow test (one ride completed + one $7 approval), ending balance ~$27.20 — main agent may reseed to reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo passenger wallet balance drifts on each backend test run (full ride flow debits price, admin-approve test credits $7). If you need a fresh $25 balance for a clean UI demo, drop the rideapp_db.users record for pasajero@rideve.com (or set wallet_balance=25) and let seed re-run, or clear rides/wallet_txns. RideMap on web is a styled grid fallback (markers are dots) — do not assert real map tiles.
